note: Every blocker below was re-read from its in-repo source before listing. blockers.title: License grant for original dataset content

blockers.why: No license grant exists; absence means all-rights-reserved by default (docs/LICENSE_DECISION_RECORD.md §1). The requirements-matrix validator tripwire fails if a license file appears without the grant commit updating this record
blockers.technicalImpact: none on tests/validators; blocks any reuse or redistribution claim

blockers.evidenceRequired: written owner choice of license(s) + grant file(s) commit
safeOptions: choose a data license (e.g. CC-BY-4.0) for original content and commit the grant file(s)
keep all-rights-reserved explicitly and document it
blockers.unblockAction: commit grant file(s) + update LICENSE_DECISION_RECORD.md §4 + flip matrix licenseStatus with evidence + update the validator tripwire
